slots.notes: Fullscreen looping background video filling the rounded CTA card behind the content (object-fit: cover, full opacity, no overlay).
Overlapping circular member-proof avatars (.av1-.av4), 32x32px, background-image cover, crop-friendly (background-position center top).

mechanic: Rounded overflow-hidden card with a fullscreen autoplay/muted/looping cover video behind left-aligned content (heading, body, pill email+button form, overlapping avatar social-proof), with CSS-only focus/hover micro-transitions and no overlay.
techDelivery: single-file HTML + Google Fonts DM Sans + inline CSS (no JS)
reskinNotes: All copy is hardcoded in markup; body background, card surface, and every text/UI color are baked as literal hex/rgba in inline CSS (no CSS variables); the page/body itself is also styled by the template (background #f0f2f7, centered flex) so embedding in a host page may require scoping; avatar images are CSS background-image with fixed 32x32 sizing and negative-margin overlap, so source crops must be square.
